_note: Query 13: aws savingsplans describe-savings-plans + aws ec2 describe-reserved-instances (both regions). Query 14: aws ce get-savings-plans-coverage --time-period Start=2026-04-01,End=2026-05-01 --granularity MONTHLY --filter '{"Dimensions":{"Key":"SERVICE","Values":["Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud - Compute"]}}' --group-by Type=DIMENSION,Key=REGION Type=DIMENSION,Key=INSTANCE_FAMILY, and aws ce get-reservation-coverage for the same window. Coverage amounts are on-demand equivalent (the plan itself bills its $4.20/hr commitment = $3,024.00 for 720 h). EC2 Instance Savings Plans are bound to one family in one region: the m5 plan covers m5 in us-east-1 only, so the eu-west-1 m5.xlarge is NOT covered.

amortizedView._note: How the covered m5 us-east-1 usage reads in the skill's cost view (usage record types at AmortizedCost). Derived from query 13 + 14, no extra call: a fully used plan costs its commitment, $4.20/hr x 720 h = $3,024.00, and Savings Plans coverage reports the same usage at its on-demand value, $4,200.00. Resizing one covered instance therefore frees about $0 until the plan ends: the $3,024.00 commitment is paid either way, and Compute Optimizer's $280.00 is an on-demand list-price figure that does not exist on this bill.

get-reservation-coverage._note: No active RIs, so RI coverage is 0% for every family.
